remarks: Welcome to this beautifully upgraded 2-bedroom townhome in the desirable Cabrini Villas community, featuring one of the largest two-bedroom floor plans in the complex. Ideally situated in a quiet interior location away from the main street, this exceptional home offers privacy, comfort, and a peaceful setting. The thoughtfully designed floor plan features two spacious primary suites, each with its own private bathroom and generous closet space. The main suite includes an enclosed balcony, creating additional versatile living space.
